WorkProcess.title: How I work
WorkProcess.description: A clear path from the first conversation to a considered design, ready for its next step.

understand.title: Understand the brief
understand.description: Get clear on the goal, audience, scope, and constraints. Start with the problem the project needs to solve.

structure.title: Map the experience
structure.description: Organize the content, map key user flows, and explore wireframes before moving into visual details.

design.title: Design the interface
design.description: Shape the visual direction in Figma, then build consistent screens, components, and responsive layouts.

refine.title: Review and refine
refine.description: Walk through the design together, gather feedback, and refine the details across screens and interaction states.

deliver.title: Build or hand off

HomeFaq.title: FAQ
HomeFaq.description: A few things to know before we work together.

projects.question: What kind of projects do you take on?
projects.answer: I focus on UI/UX design for websites and apps. I can also help with frontend development or graphic design, depending on what the project needs.

idea.question: Can we work together if I only have a rough idea?
idea.answer: Yes. We’ll talk through your goals, who you’re designing for, and the problem you want to solve. Then we’ll decide what to design first.

development.question: Can you build the website after designing it?
development.answer: Yes, if frontend development is part of the scope. For design-only projects, I hand over organized Figma files and notes for your developers.

estimate.question: How much does a project cost, and how long does it take?
estimate.answer: It depends on the scope, the number of pages or screens, and whether development is included. Once we’ve talked through the brief, I can give you a cost and timeline estimate.

brief.question: What should I share when I reach out?
brief.answer: Tell me what you’re working on, where you need help, and when you’d like to launch. Share any references or a budget range if you have them.

HomeContact.description: Tell me what you’re working on and where you need help.

ServicesPage.description: I design websites and apps, build responsive frontends, and create graphics for digital channels.

uiux.title: UI/UX Design
uiux.description: I map what people need to do, test key interactions in a prototype, and turn the agreed direction into Figma screens ready for development.

frontend.title: Frontend Development
frontend.description: I build responsive websites from approved designs using React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS. I check how layouts and interactions behave across screen sizes and account for keyboard use and performance.

graphic.title: Graphic Design
graphic.description: I create digital graphics that follow your brand’s visual direction, adapting layouts and formats to where people will see them.

pricing.title: How pricing works
pricing.description: Pricing depends on the scope, deliverables, and timeline. Share what you’re working on, and I’ll put together a quote.

designApproach.heading: Design approach
designApproach.description: Here’s what I pay attention to when designing a website or app.

goals.title: Start with what people came to do
goals.description: Before opening Figma, I clarify who the product is for, what they need to accomplish, and where the current experience gets in their way.

flow.title: Test the flow before polishing the screen
flow.description: I sketch a few directions and prototype the key interactions early. Walking through the flow helps me catch confusing steps while they’re still easy to change.

states.title: Design for the screen you’ll actually ship
states.description: I check how the interface handles long copy, small screens, loading states, and errors. My frontend background helps me account for those details while the design is still in Figma.

handoff.title: Make it easy to build on
handoff.description: I organize recurring patterns into reusable components and document the decisions a developer needs for handoff. That gives the team a clear starting point when the product changes.

AboutPage.heading: About me
AboutPage.metadataDescription: Meet Rafif Muhammad Muflihur Rodwa, a UI/UX designer and co-founder of Micholabs based in Banyuwangi, Indonesia.
AboutPage.intro: I’m a UI/UX designer based in Banyuwangi, Indonesia. I design websites and apps around what people came to do. That means thinking through the whole experience, from how someone finds the right information to what happens when a payment fails.
AboutPage.journey: I started in frontend development and graphic design in 2024. In September 2025, I began focusing on UI/UX and co-founded <company>Micholabs</company>. At the studio, I take ideas from early user flows to detailed interfaces in Figma. My frontend background helps me make decisions with the browser in mind. I think about how a layout adapts to a smaller screen, how a form handles errors, and what a button does after someone clicks it. Graphic design informs how I use type, color, and composition to make those decisions visible.
AboutPage.personal: Away from design, I write, experiment with new technology, and spend time trading and farming.
